provenance.source: Actual Jev API Noul outputs for all 500 Taxi states, four questions per call
provenance.inputs: Current decoded taxi row, column, passenger location, destination and the same static map facts exposed to every PPO arm
provenance.controls: Same four quantities have exact inexpensive rule definitions; compare Jev features with rules and zero auxiliary values
provenance.excluded: No actions, action masks, rewards, history, optimal policies, shortest paths, future simulation or expert demonstrations
provenance.accounting: Taxi physical API requests are separate from the Mario bank. All Taxi training/evaluation feature lookups use this frozen cache.
